name: last30days-skill
description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
one_liner: An AI research assistant that reads what people are actually saying across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, and prediction markets on any topic, then writes you a clear summary of the current conversation.
buyer: A marketing or trend-research agency that currently pays analysts to manually track 'what's trending' for clients across social platforms.
business_use_cases: A marketing agency produces weekly 'what's being said about your brand or industry' briefings for clients instead of manual social listening.
A VC or angel investor quickly gauges real sentiment and prediction-market odds on an emerging trend before investing.
A content creator finds what's actually being discussed right now in their niche to pick timely video or newsletter topics.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a weekly 'trend briefing' newsletter subscription for a specific niche (AI tools, crypto, fitness) built on top of it.
Offer one-off custom research reports for clients who want a deep dive on a specific topic or competitor.

steal_this: Pick a niche you know well, run this daily against it, and launch a $10/month newsletter summarizing 'what the internet is saying about X this week' by this weekend.
